name: Colonial City of Santo Domingo
description: This old quarter of Santo Domingo, on the west bank of the Ozama River, was founded in 1498 and is the oldest continuously inhabited European-founded settlement in the Americas. Its streets hold the hemisphere's first cathedral, hospital, customs house and university, along with early 16th-century landmarks such as the Alcázar de Colón and Fortaleza Ozama. Its grid layout became a model for New World towns.
